scope: Boss facing, skill selection and post-cast locomotion

phases.warning: lock aim and sprite facing together; preserve all warning durations
phases.release: mirror right-facing atlas for left casts; feint heading equals landing heading
phases.hit: existing strike timing, hitstop, camera, audio and VFX triggers unchanged
phases.residual: existing effects persist independently; blend to walk and reposition after movement unlock

motion.cast_direction: atan2(locked target - boss); do not retarget during warning or active
motion.root_motion: existing swept-obstacle path with recovery speed multiplier; side-step toward next skill range
motion.cancel_window: locomotion unlock only; next attack remains gated by original recovery and cooldown
motion.blend_curve: existing smoothstep to neutral pose; do not extend crouched attack frame

performance_budget.routing: reuse existing graph, maximum 98 nodes with current 12 props; no additional per-frame path search

validation.simulation: all 6 archetypes at waves 10 and 90, 30/60/120 Hz, 90 seconds each; all equipped moves used, post-cast travel >150px
validation.moving_target: 6 archetypes, 90 seconds each with obstacles; no model overlap; >=2 skills; post-cast travel >200px
validation.visual: actual renderer transform tested for both left and right casts
validation.browser: Waves 10-90 loaded, wave 10 ran for 20 seconds, six archetype left/right renderer review; no JavaScript exceptions

limitation: 2D atlas horizontal mirroring; no new eight-direction animation assets. Movement is intentionally locked during warning, release and initial recovery.
